verses.sanskrit:
सौतिरुवाच।
              स श्रुत्वाऽथात्मनो देहं सुपर्णः प्रेक्ष्य च स्वयम्। शरीरप्रतिसंहारमात्मनः संप्रचक्रमे॥१॥
verses.english: Sauti said : Having heard (of the hugeness of his body) and seeing it himself, he began to diminish his body.

verses.sanskrit:
सुपर्ण उवाच।
              न मे सर्वाणि भूतानि विभियुर्देहदर्शनात्। भीमरूपात्समुद्विग्रास्तस्मात्तेजस्तु संहरे॥२॥
verses.english: Garuda said: No one need be afraid of seeing my body. As you are also very much frightened at its sight, I shall diminish it.
verses.bhavadeepa: चतुर्विंशतितमः अध्यायः स इति । स सुपर्णः स्तुतिव्याजेन देवैर्बोधितस्तेभ्य आत्मनो देहं स्वरूपं श्रुत्वा प्रेक्ष्यानुभूय च सर्वभूताभयाय सौम्यो बभूवेत्यर्थः ॥१॥

verses.sanskrit:
सौतिरुवाच।
              ततः कामगमः पक्षी कामवीर्यो विहंगमः। अरुणं चात्मनः पृष्ठमारोप्य स पितुर्गृहात्॥३॥
verses.english: He enkindled all the points of the universe, he was the bird endowed with strength, capable of assuming any form at will, of going every where at will and calling any amount of energy to action at will.

verses.sanskrit: मातुरन्तिकमागच्छत्परं तीरं महोदधेः। तत्रारुणश्च निक्षिप्तो दिशं पूर्वां महाद्युतिः॥४॥
verses.english: Sauti said: Then the bird, capable of going every where at will and of calling all energy at will, placing his brother Aruna on his back, went from his father's house to that of his mother, (which was situated) on the other side of the ocean. He placed in the East Aruna of great splendour when the sun determined to burn the world with its fearful rays.

verses.sanskrit:
सूर्यस्तेजोभिरत्युग्रैर्लोकान्दग्धुमना यदा।
              रुरुरुवाच।
              किमर्थं भगवान्सूर्यो लोकान्दग्धुमनास्तदा॥५॥
verses.english: Ruru said: What for did the highly noble sun resolve to burn the world? What wrongs were done to him by the celestials, that he grew angry?
verses.bhavadeepa: सूर्यो दग्धुमना यदाऽभूत्तदा पूर्वां दिशं गत्वा तत्र सूर्यस्याग्रेऽरुणो निक्षिप्त इति योज्यम् ॥४॥

verses.sanskrit:
किमस्तापहृतं देवैर्येनेमं मन्युराविशत्।
              प्रमतिरुवाच।
              चन्द्रादित्यैर्यदा राहुराख्यातो ह्यमृतं पिबन्॥६॥
वैरानुबन्धं कृतवांश्चन्द्रादित्यौ तदाऽनघ। बाध्यमानं ग्रहेणाथ ह्यादित्ये मन्युराविशत्॥७॥
verses.english: Sauti said: sinless one, from the day on which Rahu was discovered by Surya and Chandra in the act of drinking the Ambrosia, he bore a deadly enmity towards them.

verses.sanskrit: सुरार्थाय समुत्पन्नो रोषो राहोस्तु मां प्रति। बह्वनर्थकरं पापमेकोऽहं समवाप्नुयाम्॥८॥
verses.english: When Rahu began to devour Surya, he became angry and thought. “This enmity of Rahu has risen from my benefiting the celestials,
verses.bhavadeepa: चन्द्रादित्येकत्वं च समाहारात् । ग्रहेण राहुणा ग्रहणेन वा ॥७॥

verses.sanskrit: सहाय एव कार्येषु न च कृच्छ्रेषु दृश्यते। पश्यन्ति ग्रस्यमानं मां सहन्ते वै दिवौकसः॥९॥
verses.english: And I am alone to suffer from this great evil; I do not get any help at my this difficulty.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माल्लोकविनाशार्थं ह्यवतिष्ठे न संशयः। एवं कृतमतिः सूर्यो ह्यस्तमभ्यगमद्गिरिम्॥१०॥
verses.english: The inhabitants of the celestial regions (unconcernedly) see me devoured and they quietly brook it. Therefore, I must make an attempt to destroy the worlds. There is no doubt about it.
verses.bhavadeepa: सहन्ते मर्षयन्ति सहदेवैरिति पाठे दिवौकसः उपदेवा मरीच्यादयः प्रजापतयः ॥९॥

verses.sanskrit: तस्माल्लोकविनाशाय संतापयत भास्करः। ततो देवानुपागम्य प्रोचुरेवं महर्षयः॥११॥
verses.english: With this resolution Surya went to the western mountains and from that place began to scatter his scorching rays to destroy the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: आद्यार्धरात्रसमये सर्वलोकभयावहः। उत्पत्स्यते महान्दाहस्त्रैलोक्यस्य विनाशनः॥१२॥
verses.english: Thereupon the great Rishis, came to the celestials and said; “Today in the middle of the night, a fire, fearful to all creatures, will rise to destroy the universe."
verses.bhavadeepa: सन्तापयत समतापयत । अडभाव आर्षः । तिरोभूत एव सन्नेवं दहत्युदये तु भस्मीकरिष्यति लोकानित्याह तत इत्यादिना ॥११॥

verses.sanskrit: ततो देवाः सर्षिगणा उपगम्य पितामहम्। अब्रुवन्किमिवेहाद्य महद्दाहकृतं भयम्॥१३॥
verses.english: Then the celestials with the Rishis went to the Grandsire (Brahma) and said, "What is this great and fearful heat today?"

verses.sanskrit: न तावद्दृश्यते सूर्यः क्षयोऽयं प्रतिभाति च। उदिते भगवन्भानौ कथनेतद्भविष्यति॥१४॥
verses.english: The sun has not as yet risen, still destruction of the world is obvious. What will happen when he rises?

verses.sanskrit:
पितामह उवाच।
              एष लोकविनाशाय रविरुद्यन्तुमुद्यतः। दृश्यन्नेव हि लोकान्स भस्मराशीकरिष्यति॥१५॥
verses.english: Brahma said: The sun is ready to rise in order to destroy the worlds. As soon as he will rise he will burn everything into ashes.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य प्रतिविधानं च विहितं पूर्वमेव हि। कश्यपस्य सुतो धीमानरुणेत्यभिविश्रुतः॥१६॥
verses.english: I have, however, provided the remedy beforehand.

verses.sanskrit: महाकायो महातेजाः स स्थास्यति पुरो रवेः। करिष्यति च सारथ्यं तेजश्चास्य हरिष्यति॥१७॥
verses.english: The wise son of Kashyapa, known by the name of Aruna, has a huge body. He will sit before the sun as his charioteer and will take energy. This will secure the good of the world, of the Rishis and of the celestials.

verses.sanskrit:
लोकानां स्वस्ति चैवं स्यादृषीणां च दिवौकसाम्।
              प्रमतिरुवाच।
              ततः पितामहाज्ज्ञातः सर्वं चक्रे तदाऽरुणः॥१८॥
उदितश्चैव सविता ह्यरुणेन समावृतः। एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं यत्सूर्यं मन्युराविशत्॥१९॥
verses.english: Sauti said : away all his Thereupon Aruna, ordered by the Grandsire, did all that he was commanded to do. The sun rose covered by Aruna.

verses.sanskrit: अरुणश्च यथैवास्य सारथ्यमकरोत्प्रभुः। भूय एवापरं प्रश्नं शृणु पूर्वमुदाहृतम्॥२०॥
verses.english: I have told you why Surya was in anger and how Aruna was appointed his charioteer. Hear next, the reply to the other question, asked by you a little while ago.
